summary: Unum Group filed an 8-K reporting the promotion of Andrew D. Walker to Executive Vice President, Chief Customer Operations Officer, effective July 1, 2026. The filing describes Mr. Walker's responsibilities overseeing customer operations and transformation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine internal promotion, not a special situation.
